title: Add new release repositories: etsi_its_messages
author: lreiher
body:
Two of our ROS release repositories have just been moved to ros2-gbp, see [here](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/40024) and [here](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/40025). I'd like to move a third release repository to ros2-gbp.

Also, one question: since the release repositories in here are only used for ROS2, am I right to assume that we should still keep releasing ROS1 updates to those repositories to the existing release repositories in our organization?

* Name of the release team: [ika_rwth_aachen_team](https://github.com/ros2-gbp/ros2-gbp-github-org/pull/458)

* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [ika-rwth-aachen/etsi_its_messages](https://github.com/ika-rwth-aachen/etsi_its_messages)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/master/humble/distribution.yaml#L1728)
    * [ ] There is an existing release repository which should be imported: [ika-rwth-aachen/etsi_its_messages-release](https://github.com/ika-rwth-aachen/etsi_its_messages-release)
